Workflows.title: Start a Bank Simulator session from the public NGPF landing page, confirm the account dashboard renders its checking and saving activity widgets, then view the checking account's read-only transaction activity.
Workflows.goal: The landing page displays the NGPF Bank Simulator introduction and a visible 'GET STARTED NOW' button; The app navigates to the Bank Simulator dashboard and a one-time welcome dialog is displayed; The dialog closes and the dashboard shows the Checking Account Activity widget with its available balance label and a 'VIEW ACCOUNT' control; The Account Activity page opens at type=checking with the 'Account Activity' heading, the 'Checking' account toggle, and the transaction table's 'Description' column displayed
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Open the Bank Simulator landing page — The landing page displays the NGPF Bank Simulator introduction and a visible 'GET STARTED NOW' button
2. Start the simulator session — The app navigates to the Bank Simulator dashboard and a one-time welcome dialog is displayed
3. Dismiss the welcome dialog — The dialog closes and the dashboard shows the Checking Account Activity widget with its available balance label and a 'VIEW ACCOUNT' control
4. Open the checking account's read-only activity from the dashboard — The Account Activity page opens at type=checking with the 'Account Activity' heading, the 'Checking' account toggle, and the transaction table's 'Description' column displayed
Workflows.test_name: starts a simulator session and views checking account activity
Workflows.pom_test_name: starts a simulator session and views checking account activity
